# Tiptap fixtures

What a Tiptap 3 editor holds and writes for the same page, generated by
`generate.mjs` through Tiptap's own schema (`@tiptap/html/server`):

- `core.json` / `core.html`: `editor.getJSON()` and `editor.getHTML()` of a
  page using every construct both formats carry the same way (headings,
  alignment, marks, text styles, highlights, lists, task lists, quotes, code,
  rules, tables (one with spans and every column sized, one with a single
  column resized), pictures (one centred by its own `textAlign`), hard
  breaks). docrs renders the two to the same document (`tests/tiptap.rs`).
- `extras.json` / `extras.html`: nodes whose HTML is only a placeholder for
  the editor's rendering (math, details, mentions, emoji, embeds); the JSON
  carries what the HTML does not.
- `nested.json` / `nested.html`: a table whose header is five rows deep (a
  rowspan cell, eight- and four-column spans, eight leaf columns) after two
  column borders were dragged; the editor writes each width onto every
  cell of its column, as zero-filled lists on the spanning cells.

To regenerate (in a scratch directory, so the packages stay out of the
repository), run the `npm install` listed at the top of `generate.mjs`,
then `node generate.mjs <this directory>`. The script prints the Tiptap
version it used; the committed files come from `@tiptap/core` 3.32.0.
